verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents attaching over CDP to any running Chromium browser by URL (localBrowser.connect), and it offers familiar Playwright-style page methods. This lets it work alongside an existing CDP-driven browser. However, the evidence never shows existing Playwright or Puppeteer code connecting to Stagehand/Browserbase-launched browsers unchanged, so drop-in reuse without rewriting is only implied. Missing for 10: documented connection of existing Playwright/Puppeteer clients to Stagehand-provisioned browsers (e.g., an exposed CDP/WebSocket endpoint), explicit Puppeteer support, and hands-on corroboration of reusing existing scripts.
